edges.description: Reduced ALG1 activity causes accumulation of incomplete dolichol-pyrophosphate-linked GlcNAc2 (and GlcNAc1) precursors before mannosylation.
Oligosaccharyltransferase-mediated transfer of incomplete precursors, together with under-occupied glycosylation sites, produces proteins bearing truncated N-glycans and a type I transferrin pattern.
intermediate_mechanisms: Transfer of incomplete lipid-linked oligosaccharides to nascent proteins and site under-occupancy.

edges.description: Widespread abnormal N-glycosylation is associated with neurologic, ocular, hepatic, hematologic, gastrointestinal, renal, skeletal, and immune manifestations, while the specific client proteins driving each remain unresolved.

evidence.snippet: Genetic analysis of the patient's hALG1 gene identified a homozygous mutation leading to the exchange of a serine residue to leucine at position 258 in the hALG1 protein.

nodes.description: Pathogenic ALG1 variants impair the ER beta-1,4-mannosyltransferase that adds the first mannose to dolichol-pyrophosphate-GlcNAc2 during lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly.

evidence.reference_title: ALG1-CDG: Clinical and Molecular Characterization of 39 Unreported Patients.
evidence.snippet: ALG1 encodes a β1,4 mannosyltransferase that catalyzes the addition of the first of nine mannose moieties to form a dolichol-lipid linked oligosaccharide intermediate required for proper N-linked glycosylation.

evidence.reference_title: Deficiency of the first mannosylation step in the N-glycosylation pathway causes congenital disorder of glycosylation type Ik.
evidence.snippet: The accumulation pattern suggested a deficiency of the ALG1 beta1,4 mannosyltransferase, which adds the first mannose residue to lipid-linked oligosaccharides.

nodes.description: Transfer of incomplete ALG1-associated oligosaccharides and site under-occupancy produce hypoglycosylated glycoproteins, detectable as a type I serum transferrin pattern and, more specifically, as the ALG1-associated xeno-tetrasaccharide NeuAc-Gal-GlcNAc2.
